name: Deer hunting season dates by state, 2026–27: archery, firearm and muzzleloader seasons from state wildlife agencies
description: The 2026–27 deer season dates for each US state, one record per state per season type (archery, firearm/gun, muzzleloader, youth), taken from the state wildlife agency's own published season table. Dates change every year, many states set them by formula ('Saturday before Thanksgiving'), and unit-level exceptions are common — so the unaided answer is usually last year's date or a content-mill guess. Each record carries the statewide date range as printed and a flag when the agency's page shows unit/zone variation. Answers 'when does gun deer season open in Wisconsin in 2026?', 'is archery season still open in Pennsylvania in December?', and 'do Wisconsin and Minnesota firearm seasons overlap?'
licence: State government publications; season dates are facts. We take the dates plus short attributed quotes linking to the agency page. No compilation is copied — each record comes from its own state's page.
